intent.productGoal: Build reusable run-bound Revenue Sustainability analysis without autonomous professional normalization.
intent.capability: Shared comparison/coverage/decomposition evidence layer across provider, payer, service line, location, and patient responsibility.
architecturalIntent: Evidence and professional judgment remain separate.
Comparison scope is immutable and explicit.
Residuals and unsupported evidence remain visible.
invariants: No patient responsibility inferred from patient cash.
acceptanceEvidence: Core tests, typechecks, build, RS-PAYER-SHIFT-001 attempted run, and documented patient-source limitation.

observedBehaviour: Run-bound sustainability analysis, Analyze surface, and workbook evidence sheets were implemented.
Payer proof exposed a scope reconciliation defect without forcing a balance.
Patient responsibility was withheld pending a dedicated source contract.

evidence.result: Payer comparison executed; G3 remained blocked by visible bank-scope difference.
Records implemented architecture and remaining boundaries.

divergences.expected: Payer current-period controls reconcile under the declared comparison window.
divergences.observed: Bank reconciliation includes prior-period deposits because its filter is valuation-bounded rather than analysis-period-bounded.

divergences.expected: Patient responsibility can be calculated from source evidence.
divergences.observed: Current sources provide patient collections but no dedicated responsibility obligation/balance contract.

learning.recurringPattern: Shared period scope must be applied identically to every comparative control population.
learning.improvementProposal: Add a dedicated patient responsibility source model after explicit authority.
durableKnowledge: Patient cash is not patient responsibility.
Payer decomposition must retain residuals and evidence-only state.
